config.selection: For each model/task, greedily approximate its OWN complete discovery-anchor finite update with subsets of whole bilinear products. No coefficients refit; order frozen before evaluation. All7 counts retained. Not selection on teacher/evaluation effects.
config.matching: Cosine of full output⊗symmetric-input bilinear tensor; analytical Gram handles left/right swaps and compensating signs, independent of factor norm gauges. Hungarian permutation from tensors only.16 signed ambient coordinate permutation nulls of second model, same transform input/output.
config.limits: Supervised student and task-conditioned subset selection; model weights highdimensional, product count not total description length. Discovery-preserving subsets need not preserve teacher computation or downstream output.

functional_matching_protocol: Posthoc alternative to weight tensor matching: Hungarian on full product response matrices from discovery anchors only, equal per-task teacher effect normalization. Frozen assignment evaluated on H849 full contrasts. No refitting. Aggregate agreement is distinct from atom identity.
